title: Mayors to get powers to overrule local councils on planning decisions
description: Housing minister Matthew Pennycook said the change was "essential" for helping mayors "effectively deliver new homes".

title: Two police officers among seven killed in wrong-way car crash
description: PC Matthew Blades and PC Tom Clough died after a car driving the wrong way down the A66 near Middlesbrough collided with a police vehicle.

title: Trump says Canada wants 'benefits' of being US state as Carney says countries in trade war
description: Canada's prime minister said he was "reluctantly" announcing retaliatory tariffs as he accused the US of starting a trade war.
